zh-CN.shortDescription: 将 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 的画面、音乐和兼容视频投放到 Windows 电脑。
zh-CN.description:
ClearCast 让 Windows 电脑成为 AirPlay 接收端，用于展示屏幕内容、播放音乐和接收兼容播放器的视频。

将设备与电脑连接到同一局域网，在设备的「屏幕镜像」或播放器的 AirPlay 选项中选择 ClearCast。局域网需要允许设备相互访问。

- 接收屏幕画面和声音，支持全屏、90° 旋转和等比缩放。
- 音乐投放时显示发送端提供的封面、曲名、歌手、专辑和进度。
- 从封面生成流动背景，随节奏疏密调速，并在强低频鼓点时自然回弹；切换到设置或关于页仍继续流动。
- 发送端支持时，显示播放、暂停和上一首、下一首控件；不支持时继续在发送设备上操作。
- 可选择在新视频投放开始时自动全屏，纯音乐不会自动全屏。
- 使用四位验证码配对并管理已保存的设备；提供中文、英文及浅色、深色主题。

播放进度仅供查看，不能拖动定位。封面、曲目信息、播放控制及视频兼容性取决于发送设备、播放器和内容。
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
1.2.0.0

新增 AirPlay 音乐展示和兼容视频投放：显示封面、曲名、歌手、专辑与只读进度，在发送端提供能力时支持播放、暂停及切歌。新增封面纹理流动背景，按真实音乐的节奏疏密平滑调速，并在强低频鼓点时短促放大、自然回弹；浅色背景的封面颜色更鲜明，前景封面和控件保持稳定。

新增视频投放时自动全屏设置，纯音乐不受影响。已认证设备连接后显示「AirPlay 已连接」，断开后恢复等待；暂停和播放结束不会误报断开。优化首次验证码反馈与同设备双栈地址切换，统一应用图标并缩小标题栏 Logo。

进度不能拖动定位；封面、控制与视频支持情况取决于发送设备、播放器和内容。

en-US.shortDescription: Receive AirPlay screen mirroring, music, and compatible video on a Windows PC.
en-US.description:
ClearCast turns a Windows PC into an AirPlay receiver for screen sharing, music, and video from compatible players.

Connect your device and PC to the same local network, then select ClearCast in Screen Mirroring or your player's AirPlay menu. The network must allow the devices to communicate.

- Receive screen video and audio, use full screen, rotate by 90 degrees, and preserve the picture's aspect ratio.
- Show artwork, title, artist, album, and playback progress supplied with music.
- Enjoy a flowing artwork background that changes pace with rhythmic density and adds a natural rebound on strong low-frequency beats. It keeps flowing on Settings and About.
- Use play, pause, previous, and next when the sender supports them; otherwise, control playback on your device.
- Optionally enter full screen when a new video session begins. Audio-only sessions stay in the normal window.
- Pair with a four-digit code and manage saved devices. Choose Chinese or English and light or dark themes.

Progress is read-only and cannot be dragged to seek. Artwork, metadata, playback controls, and video compatibility depend on the sending device, player, and content.
en-US.releaseNotes:
1.2.0.0

Adds AirPlay music presentation and compatible video playback. View artwork, title, artist, album, and read-only progress, with play, pause, and track controls when the sender supports them. A flowing artwork background changes pace with the music's rhythmic density and adds a short, naturally damped rebound on strong low-frequency beats. Light backgrounds retain richer artwork colors while foreground artwork and controls stay still.

Adds an optional automatic full-screen setting for new video sessions, leaving audio-only sessions unaffected. Authenticated devices now show AirPlay connected and return to waiting after disconnecting; pauses and playback endings retain a still-active connection. Improves first-code feedback and same-device dual-stack address changes. Updates the app icons and uses a smaller title-bar logo.

Progress cannot be dragged to seek. Artwork, controls, and video support depend on the sending device, player, and content.
